value.rationale: The natural class of simultaneously geometrically smooth, rationally base-point-free cubic pencils is central to two published research questions; a complete orbit census determines its moduli types and exact blocking distribution. The existence of three projective classes, comprising 504 pencils, that cannot extend to any smooth cubic net is a substantive structural boundary and is not derived merely by tabulating already classified nets.
